prompt:
PLAN 11 | THE BLADE AND THE COMMAND | 15 SECONDS

Create a horizontal 16:9 cinematic sequence for Seedance 2.5.
Three shots lasting four, six and five seconds.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
Zahhak and his living shoulder serpents = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}

ANIMAL REFERENCE:
Cat = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

PROP REFERENCES:
Staff = {{PROP_STAFF}}
Blade = {{PROP_BLADE}}

REFERENCE INTERPRETATION:
Preserve identities, masks, costumes and object designs. Relight the subjects as described here.

LOCATION AND LIGHTING:
The characters stand inside a chamber entirely concealed by darkness.

Exactly one hard overhead spotlight illuminates the compact group from directly above.

Cold-neutral highlights define upper mask planes, shoulders, hands, the cat and sections of the living serpents. Shadows beneath faces and arms remain deep.

The surrounding image is solid black. Walls, columns and floor remain unexposed. Frame the action from the waist upward.

Maintain fixed exposure and constant spotlight intensity throughout. Every cut retains the same black surroundings.

START STATE:
Shahrnaz stands WEST and Arnavaz EAST, both facing NORTH.
Both are calm and possessed.
Shahrnaz holds the cat against her chest.

Zahhak stands NORTH of their midpoint, facing SOUTH.
His RIGHT hand holds the staff.
A single blade is concealed beneath the rear-left layer of his garment.

SHOT 26A | 00:00–00:04 | EXTRACTION

50mm waist-up view from EAST, looking WEST.

Arnavaz is screen-left in profile, facing screen-right.
Zahhak is screen-right, facing screen-left.
Shahrnaz stands farther away, partly screened by Arnavaz.

Zahhak shifts slightly to stand directly before Arnavaz.

Keeping the staff in his right hand, he reaches beneath the rear-left garment layer with his LEFT hand and draws out the blade by its handle.

Keep the hand and displaced fabric visible so the object’s origin is clear.

The blade catches the overhead light as he brings it forward.

SHOT 26B | 00:04–00:10 | HANDOVER

65mm closer view from the SAME EASTERN side.

Arnavaz remains screen-left, facing right.
Zahhak remains screen-right, facing left.

Show their opposing mask profiles and hands together.

Zahhak holds the pommel end in his LEFT fingers, leaving the main grip exposed. The blade points downward.

Arnavaz closes her RIGHT hand around the grip.
Zahhak releases it only after her fingers are secure.

She lowers the blade toward her right hip.
Her LEFT hand remains empty.

Hold the entire transfer in one continuous shot with a slight forward camera drift.

SHOT 26C | 00:10–00:15 | DIRECTION

40mm waist-up view from SOUTH, looking NORTH.

Shahrnaz’s BACK occupies screen-left.
Arnavaz’s BACK occupies screen-right.
Zahhak’s FRONT is visible beyond them.

Zahhak raises the staff head into Arnavaz’s sightline, then directs it toward the cat in Shahrnaz’s arms on screen-left.

Arnavaz’s head follows. She turns WEST toward Shahrnaz.
Shahrnaz turns EAST toward Arnavaz, still carrying the cat.

Zahhak lowers the staff.

End with the sisters facing each other and the blade held low in Arnavaz’s right hand.

LIVING SERPENTS:
Visible serpents continuously make subtle independent neck turns, muscular adjustments and slow slides across the garment. Preserve their referenced single-headed anatomy.

SOUND:
Clothing opening, fingers adjusting around the handle, calm breathing, staff movement and quiet scales.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_1>>> is Zahhak (CHR-001 V08); match it wherever Zahhak appears.
<<<image_2>>> is Arnavaz (CHR-004 V01); match it wherever Arnavaz appears.
<<<image_3>>> is Shahrnaz (CHR-005 V01); match it wherever Shahrnaz appears.
<<<image_4>>> is Cat Persian Longhair (CRT-004 V01); match it wherever Cat Persian Longhair appears.
<<<image_5>>> is Dagger Horse Head (PRP-019 V02); match it wherever Dagger Horse Head appears.
<<<image_6>>> is Staff - Bronze Cobra (PRP-001 V01); match it wherever Staff - Bronze Cobra appears.
